name: Gradient Wipe Reveal
description: Two lines are revealed left to right by a feathered matte while drifting in; the matte keeps travelling to wipe them off.
move: Two lines are revealed left to right by a feathered matte while drifting in; the matte keeps travelling to wipe them off.
how: A CSS mask-image linear gradient with two edges driven by custom properties: --in (leading edge) and --out (trailing edge), each with a 14% feather. --in runs -20%→120% over 1.3s with cubic-bezier(0.6,0,0.2,1) and x -28→0; exit runs --out the same way with power2.in.
adapt: Each masked element needs width:max-content so percentages are relative to the text, not the stage. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Linear Wipe with feather" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
